about_the_game:
Blightrest is a co-op survival action game set in a dark, open world where every decision brings you closer to either salvation or eternal damnation. Master survival, build fortifications, banish demons with ancient rituals, and explore the Wastes where even shadows have eyes.

🩸 EXPLORE A WORLD CURSED BY BLIGHT

The Wastes are a forsaken land where lost souls wander, trapped between life and death. Abandoned villages, dead forests, and ruined temples hold secrets, fragments of the past, and ancient artifacts. But beware — nightfall awakens the blight, demons, and shadowy creatures that hunt relentlessly.

Venture alone or in co-op with up to 4 players and uncover the truth behind this world… and your soul.

🛡️ SURVIVE, BUILD, DEFEND

Create your refuge in the heart of the Wastes:

  • Build fortifications, totems, and traps to survive the onslaught of night creatures.

  • Craft tools, armor, and weapons necessary for survival.

  • Construct altars and magical seals to empower your banishing rituals.

Your shelter is the only thing keeping your soul from dissolving into darkness.

📜 MASTER THE ART OF BANISHMENT

Collect fragments of ancient spells and uncover forgotten rites to perform demon-banishing rituals.

Each successful banishment brings you closer to freedom… but the cost of failure is your soul.

🩸 FIGHT DEMONIC ABOMINATIONS

  • Unique enemies from the depths of demonology: vampires, demons, and twisted souls.

  • Each foe has distinct weaknesses: light, silver, magic, fire.

  • Use everything you find to survive and prevail.

⚔️ EMBRACE OR ESCAPE YOUR CURSED FATE

You are a prisoner of the Wastes. Find all the fragments of the Grand Liberation Spell to reclaim your soul… or remain forever in Blightrest.

Will you banish the darkness...
...or will the darkness banish you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590 or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
